Vendor / rippling pricing

Rippling pricing in 2026

Rippling does not publish list rates. Buying-committee evidence puts the Core HRIS platform at $8 PEPM as a floor, with Payroll, IT/Device, Performance, and Recruiting layering 30-60% on top. A typical 100-employee SaaS on Core + Payroll + IT lands at $14-$18 PEPM all-in. Implementation runs $3,500-$12,000 depending on module count.

What the buying committee actually pays

Stack-priced. Real all-in for 100 employees on Core + Payroll + IT typically lands $14-$18 PEPM. The ledger applies a default 12% annual renewal uplift unless the buyer caps it in the MSA - our own central modelling assumption, adjustable on the renewal-uplift page, not a vendor-published rate.

What does the $8 PEPM floor actually include?

The $8 floor reflects the Core HRIS platform: directory, org chart, employee data, document storage, time-off, basic reporting. Payroll, IT/Device, Performance, Recruiting, and Benefits Admin are priced per-module on top, each adding $3-$6 PEPM.

How much do the modules add?

Payroll typically adds $6 PEPM, IT/Device $6 PEPM, Performance $3 PEPM, Recruiting $4 PEPM, Benefits Admin $5 PEPM in observed quotes. A four-module stack therefore lands around $14-$18 PEPM at mid-market headcount.

What is the typical Rippling implementation fee?

$3,500-$5,500 for a 100-employee Core + Payroll deployment, $8,000-$12,000 for 250 employees on five modules. Multi-module migrations push the higher end of the band.

Does Rippling charge an SSO upgrade?

SAML SSO is not gated behind a separate SKU. SCIM provisioning sits in IT, which is itself a paid module ($6 PEPM observed).

How does Rippling PEPM scale on renewal?

Standard 12% annual renewal uplift unless capped in the MSA. Capping at 5-7% is achievable with multi-year commits.
